expected.result_summary: Renowned for learning, craftsmanship and the arts; fortunate and fierce in war; energetic and fond of roaming. The Sun is at its best in Aries.
expected.sanskrit: शास्त्रार्थकृतिकलाभिः ख्यातो युद्धश्रियः प्रचण्डश्च । उद्युक्तो भ्रमणरुचिः … क्रिये श्रेष्ठः ॥

expected.result_summary: Tormented by disease of the mouth and eyes, yet able to bear hardship; devout, occupied with business, amorous, and averse to barren women; supplied with food, garlands, clothing and perfumes, versed in song, instrument and dance — and afraid of water.
expected.sanskrit: वदनाक्षिरोगतप्तः क्लेशसहिष्णुर्न चापि बहुशः । भक्तो व्यवहाररतो रतिमान् वन्ध्याङ्गनाद्वेषी ॥ भोजनमाल्याच्छादनगन्धयुतो गेयवाद्यनृत्तज्ञः । दिवसकरे वृषसंस्थे भवति पुमान् सलिलभीरुश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: Intelligent, sweet of speech, affectionate, correct in learned conduct; skilled in the sciences and the sastras, wealthy, generous in his dealings; adept, an astronomer, of middling build, having two mothers, fortunate, and modest.
expected.sanskrit: मेधावी वाग्मधुरो वात्सल्यगुणैर्युतः श्रुताचारः । विज्ञानशास्त्रकुशलो बहुवित्त उदारचेष्टश्च ॥ निपुणो ज्योतिषवेत्ता मध्यमरूपो द्विमातृकः सुभगः । मिथुनस्थे दिनभर्तरि जातः पुरुषो विनीतः स्यात् ॥

expected.result_summary: Unsteady in his undertakings, famed for kingly qualities, yet hostile to his own party; of small fortune, handsome, afflicted by phlegm and bile, worn out by toil; fond of drink, even-handed in duty, proud, a knower of fine speech, of countries and of the directions; of long standing, and hostile to his father's people.
expected.sanskrit: कर्मसु चपलः ख्यातो गुणैर्नृपाणां स्वपक्षविद्वेषी । स्वल्पभगः सुरूपः कफपित्तार्तः श्रमाभिसन्तप्तः ॥ मद्यरुचिः समधर्मा मानी वरवाक्यदेशदिग्वेत्ता । सूर्ये कुलीरसंस्थे बहुस्थितिः पितृगणद्वेष्टा ॥

expected.result_summary: A slayer of enemies, prone to anger, distinguished in action, roaming forests, hills and fastnesses; energetic, brave in spirit, lustrous, a meat-eater, terrible; grave, steady in courage, hard of hearing, a protector of land, abounding in wealth, and famous.
expected.sanskrit: रिपुहन्ता क्रोधपरो विशिष्टचेष्टो वनाद्रिदुर्गचरः । उत्साही सत्त्वशूरस्तेजस्वी मांसभक्षणो रौद्रः ॥ गम्भीरः स्थिरसत्त्वो बधिरः क्षितिपालको धनसमृद्धः । सिंहस्थे दिवसकरे ख्यातः पुरुषो भवेज्जातः ॥

expected.result_summary: Of a body like a woman's, modest, versed in writing, weak of sight, pleasing in talk; intelligent, of slight force, learned, attentive upon gods and gurus; skilled in massage and like work, contented with scripture, song and speech, and soft and humble in his words.
expected.sanskrit: स्त्रीतुल्यतनुर्ह्रीमान् लिपिवेत्ता दुर्दृशश्च वल्गुकथः । मेधावी लघुसत्त्वो विद्वान् शुश्रूषकः सुरगुरूणाम् ॥ संवाहनादिकर्मसु दक्षः श्रुतिगेयवाक्परितुष्टः । कन्यायां दिवसकरे जातो मृदुदीनवाक्यश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: Afflicted by wasting of the limbs and by expenditure, disliked as a man greedy for foreign roads; his affections spoilt by low company, living by trade in gold, iron and the like; hateful, busied with other men's work, attached to other men's wives, unclean, humiliated, and stripped of his pride.
expected.sanskrit: अङ्गक्षयव्ययार्तो विदेशमार्गादिलम्पटे द्विष्टः । नीचोपहतप्रीतिर्हिरण्यलोहादिपण्यजीवी च ॥ द्वेष्यः परकर्मरतः परदाररतिः पुमान् भवेन्मलिनः । सूर्ये तुलाधरस्थे वृषपरिभूतः प्रगतस्मयश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: Unstoppable in the rush of battle; devoted to scripture and duty yet untruthful and dull; ruined through wicked women, cruel, and subject to bad wives; wrathful, of bad conduct, exceedingly greedy, fond of quarrel, speaking falsehood; seized by weapon, fire and poison, and unlucky for his father and mother.
expected.sanskrit: अनिवारितरणवेगः श्रुतिधर्मरतो न सत्यवाङ् मूर्खः । प्रविनष्टदुष्टयुवतिः क्रूरः कुस्त्रीविधेयश्च ॥ क्रोधपरोऽसद्वृत्तो लोभिष्ठः कलहवल्लभोऽनृतवाक् । शस्त्राग्निविषग्रस्तः पितुर्जनन्याश्च दुर्भगः कीटे ॥

expected.result_summary: Possessed of goods, liked by the king, wise, devoted to gods and brahmins; skilled in weapons, missiles and the training of elephants, and fit for affairs; honoured by the good, tranquil, wealthy, with a broad, full and handsome body, a benefactor of his kin, and happy.
expected.sanskrit: द्रव्यान्वितो नृपेष्टो जातः प्राज्ञः सुरद्विजानुरतः । शस्त्रास्त्रहस्तिशिक्षानिपुणो व्यवहारयोग्यश्च ॥ पूज्यः सतां प्रशान्तो धनवान् विस्तीर्णपीनचारुतनुः । बन्धूनां हितकारी सुखयुतः कार्मुके सूर्ये ॥

expected.result_summary: Fond of wandering, of little force, everything of his destroyed by the disaffection of his own party, and a great eater; greedy, attached to bad women, grown up in evil deeds, and full of craving.
expected.sanskrit: अटनप्रियोऽल्पसत्त्वः स्वपक्षविक्षोभनाशितसमस्तः । मकरस्थे दिवसकरे जातो बहुभक्षकः पुरुषः ॥ लुब्धः कुस्त्रीसक्तः कुकर्मसंवर्धितः सतृष्णः ॥

expected.result_summary: Suffering from heart disease, having many sons, censured by good men, and exceedingly wrathful; favoured by other men's wives, and decided in his undertakings; mostly sorrowful, of little wealth, his friendships slackened, of unclean appearance, a slanderer, and hard to reach.
expected.sanskrit: हृद्रोगी बहुसुतः सतां विगर्ह्योऽतिरोषश्च । परदाराणां सुभगः कर्मस्विति निश्चितो भवति ॥ दुःखप्रायोऽल्पधनः श्लथितसौहृदो मलिनमूर्तिः । कुम्भधरेऽर्के जातः पिशुनः स्यात् दुष्प्रापश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: One who gathers friends about him, dear to women, obtaining an abundance of comfort; giving much good to the king, waxing and waning in wealth and fame; famed through good sons, servants and friends, wealthy through trade on water, well-spoken yet a teller of untruth, afflicted by a severe disease of the private parts, and having many siblings.
expected.sanskrit: सुहृदां संग्रहशीलः स्त्रीप्रियो लब्धसौख्यसंभारः । राज्ञो बहुशुभदः क्षयोदयी भवति धनकीर्त्या ॥ सत्पुत्रभृत्याप्तयशा जलपण्यधनः सुवागनृतवादी । ऊर्जितगुह्यरुगार्तो बहुसहजो मीनसंस्थेऽर्के ॥

expected.result_summary: Given to giving, a benefactor of many, dear to young women, and soft of body.
expected.sanskrit: दानरतो बहुभ्यो हितो युवतिप्रियो मृदुशरीरः

expected.result_summary: Of terrible valour in battle, cruel, with reddened eyes, hands and feet, and endowed with lustre and strength.
expected.sanskrit: सङ्ग्रामोत्कटवीर्यः क्रूरः संरक्तनेत्रकरचरणः … तेजोबलोपेतः

expected.result_summary: Busied with other men's work, poor in wealth, low in spirit, full of sorrow, and unclean of body.
expected.sanskrit: प्रकर्मरतो मन्दधनः सत्त्वदीनो बहुदुःखः … मलिनकायश्च

expected.result_summary: Happy and wealthy, a giver, a king's minister or else a commander of forces; he is born excellent.
expected.sanskrit: सुखी विणो दाता नृपमन्त्री दण्डनायको वापि … जायते श्रेष्ठः

expected.result_summary: Attached to base women, his kinsfolk repeatedly diminished, and wretched.
expected.sanskrit: कुत्सितरामासक्तो बहुशः क्षीणबान्धवो दीनः

expected.result_summary: His body steeped in pain, frenzied in his undertakings, confused in mind, and a fool.
expected.sanskrit: दुःखपरिप्लुतदेहः कार्योन्मादी भवेद्विमूढमतिः … मूर्खः

expected.result_summary: Attached to courtesans, weighty in speech, resorted to by many young women, and living by water.
expected.sanskrit: वेश्यारतिर्गुरुवचाः बहुयुवतिसमाश्रयो भवति … सलिलजीवी

expected.result_summary: Brave, delighting in battle, lustrous, his wealth and fame won by daring, and formidable.
expected.sanskrit: शूरः सङ्ग्रामरुचिस्तेजस्वी साहसार्जितधनकीर्तिः … पुमान् विकटः

expected.result_summary: Exceedingly clever in writing, documents, poetry, books and song, and of a fine body.
expected.sanskrit: लिपिलेख्यकाव्यपुस्तकगेयादिविधावतीव निपुणमतिः … भवेत् सुतनुः

expected.result_summary: With many good friends and a strong party, a king's counsellor, of beautiful eyes, charming — a king.
expected.sanskrit: बहुशुभमित्रपक्षो नृपसचिवश्चारुलोचनः कान्तः … नृपतिः

expected.result_summary: A king or a king's minister, joined with women and wealth in abundance, intelligent and steadfast.
expected.sanskrit: नृपतिर्नृपमन्त्री वा स्त्रीधनबहुयोगसंयुतो मतिमान् … भवेद्धीरः

expected.result_summary: Low, idle, poor, consorting with old women, uneven in character, and tormented by disease.
expected.sanskrit: नीचोऽलसो दरिद्रो वृद्धस्त्रीसङ्गतो विषमशीलः … व्याधिसन्तप्तः

expected.result_summary: Pained by enemies and by his own kin, distressed by travel abroad, and much given to lamentation.
expected.sanskrit: रिपुबान्धवकृतपीडा विदेशगमनार्दितो बहुविलापी

expected.result_summary: Beset with fear of enemies and with quarrels, pained by fighting and slander, wretched and full of shame.
expected.sanskrit: रिपुभयकलहसमेतो रणापवादादिदुःखितो दीनः … सव्रीडः

expected.result_summary: Of kingly conduct, famous, surrounded by kinsmen and abandoned by his enemies, but afflicted with eye disease.
expected.sanskrit: नृपतिचरितः ख्यातो बान्धवसहितोऽरिभिश्च संत्यक्तः … अक्ष्यामययुतः

expected.result_summary: His face torn by many weapons, struck down by the king, going abroad, fierce, and always frenzied.
expected.sanskrit: बहुशस्त्रदारितमुखो राज्ञा हतो विदेशगश्चण्डः … सदोन्मादः

expected.result_summary: Happy in wealth, wife and sons, little wearied, little diseased, comfortable, and fickle.
expected.sanskrit: धनदारपुत्रसुखितो मन्दखेदः स्वल्पनामयः सुखितः … भवेच्चपलः

expected.result_summary: His mind much agitated, forever engaged in maintaining many relatives, and a gambler.
expected.sanskrit: बहुभूलोद्विग्नमना बहुबन्धुविपोषणे सदा निरतः … कितवः

expected.result_summary: A king or the equal of a king, steady in wealth from trade on water, and cruel.
expected.sanskrit: राजा राजसमो वा जलपण्यधनधीरः क्रूरः

expected.result_summary: Tormented by swellings and fistula, and estranged from his kinsmen.
expected.sanskrit: शोरषभगन्दरयोगैः सन्तप्तो बन्धुभिः सह विरक्तः

expected.result_summary: Famed for learning, honour and fame, dear to the king, and adept.
expected.sanskrit: विद्यामानयशोभिः ख्यातो नृपवल्लभो भवेन्निपुणः … विगतरात्रः

expected.result_summary: Foremost, a king's minister or an army commander, very well known, and abounding in the arts.
expected.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठो राज्ञो मन्त्री सेनानाथोऽथ सुप्रसिद्धश्च … कलाभ्यधिकः

expected.result_summary: A server of women, wealthy through young women, doing other men's work, fierce in battle, and pleasant in speech.
expected.sanskrit: स्त्रीसेवी युवतिधनः परकार्यकरो रणे प्रचण्डश्च … प्रियालापः

expected.result_summary: Afflicted by diseases of phlegm and wind, a taker of others' property, contrary in thought and act, and a slanderer.
expected.sanskrit: कफमारुतरोगार्तः परस्वहारी विरोधमतिचेष्टः … पिशुनः

expected.result_summary: Intelligent, with a good wife, troubled by phlegm, and dear to the king.
expected.sanskrit: मेधावी सुकलत्रः कफार्दितो भूपवल्लभो मनुजः

expected.result_summary: Attached to other men's wives, brave, given to daring, industrious, terrible, and a chief.
expected.sanskrit: परदाररतः शूरः साहसकारी कृतोद्यमो रुद्रः … प्रधानश्च

expected.result_summary: Learned, a writer of documents, keeping company with gamblers, abject over other men's wives, and not of great courage.
expected.sanskrit: विद्वान् लिपिलेख्यकरः कितवासेवी परस्त्रीमतिदीनः … न बहुसत्त्वः

expected.result_summary: He builds temples, gardens and tanks; of surpassing courage, fond of solitude, and of great intellect.
expected.sanskrit: देवारामतटाकान् करोति सत्त्वाधिको विजनशीलः … महाबुद्धिः

expected.result_summary: Overcome by piles and by leprosy, pitiless, and without passion.
expected.sanskrit: दुर्नामकुष्ठरोगैरभिभूतो निर्दयो विगतरजः

expected.result_summary: Skilled at the destruction of bodies, born impotent, and a tormentor of others.
expected.sanskrit: कायविनाशनदक्षः षण्डो जातः परोपतापकरः

expected.result_summary: Endowed with purity of speech, with wealth and with sons, equal to a king, free of grief, and of good body.
expected.sanskrit: वाक्शुद्धिविभवपुत्रैः समन्वितो नृपसमो विगतशोकः … सुशरीरः

expected.result_summary: Winning fame in battle, plain of speech, provided with wealth and comfort, and fierce.
expected.sanskrit: सङ्ग्रामे लब्धयशाः स्फुटवचनो वित्तसौख्यसम्पन्नः … चण्डः

expected.result_summary: Sweet of speech, versed in writing, knowing poetry, the arts, learned assemblies, vehicles and metals, and approved by people.
expected.sanskrit: मधुरवचनो लिपिज्ञः काव्यकलागोष्ठियानधातुज्ञः … जनसंमतो भवति

expected.result_summary: He moves about in the palaces of kings, or is himself a king, provided with elephants, horses and wealth, and always learned.
expected.sanskrit: विचरति नरेन्द्रभवने नृपतिर्वा वारणाश्वधनयुक्तः … सदा विद्वान्

expected.result_summary: Enjoying women of divine beauty, attended by perfumes and garlands, and tranquil.
expected.sanskrit: दिव्यस्त्रीभोगयुतः सुगन्धमाल्यादिभिः सहितः … शान्तः

expected.result_summary: Unclean, calling himself wise, attached to low people, and sporting with four-footed beasts.
expected.sanskrit: अशुचिः प्राज्ञकाह्वी नीचानुरतः चतुष्पदक्रीडः

expected.result_summary: Adept in deceit, fickle of mind, his wealth and comfort lost through the company of women.
expected.sanskrit: मायापटुश्चलमतिः स्त्रीसङ्गान्नष्टधनसौख्यः

expected.result_summary: Seized by diseases and by enemies, his body wounded by weapons in other men's quarrels, and crippled.
expected.sanskrit: व्याधिभिररिभिर्ग्रस्तः परकलहात् शस्त्रविक्षतशरीरः … विकलः

expected.result_summary: Brave, of impotent nature, a taker of others' property, and ruined in all his limbs.
expected.sanskrit: शूरः षण्डप्रकृतिः परस्वहारी नष्टसर्वाङ्गः

expected.result_summary: Of splendid deeds, intelligent, a refuge for all, of wide fame, and high-minded.
expected.sanskrit: शोभनकर्मा मतिमान् सर्वेषामाश्रयो विपुलकीर्तिः … मनस्वी च

expected.result_summary: He lives by conch, coral and gems, is enriched through courtesans, and is born happy.
expected.sanskrit: शङ्खप्रवालमणिभिर्जीवति वेश्याङ्गनाधनसमृद्धः … सुखी जातः

expected.result_summary: He destroys the party of his enemies, his confidence swelled by the honours of kings.
expected.sanskrit: ध्वंसयति शत्रुपक्षं नरेन्द्रसन्मानवर्धिताश्वासः

expected.result_summary: Devoted to deeds of daring, subject to disorders of bile and blood yet possessed of lustre and courage: with the Sun in its own or exaltation rasi the man born becomes a ruler of men.
expected.sanskrit: साहसकर्माभिरतः पित्तासृग्व्याधिकान्तिसत्त्वयुतः । सूर्ये भवति नरेन्द्रः स्वतुङ्गराशौ नरो जातः ॥

expected.result_summary: With hands and feet of a lotus hue, having wealth and children; sweating readily, afraid of water, devoted to women, with an ill-shaped head, and ruled by women — thus the Moon in Aries.
expected.sanskrit: पद्माभैः पाणिपादैर्वित्तसुतजनो बकैलाकारनेत्रः । ससेदस्तोयभीस्त्रैणविकृतशिराः स्त्रीजितो मेष इन्दौ ॥

expected.result_summary: Broad-chested, a great giver, with thick curling hair, amorous, and full of renown; charming, having daughters, with eyes like a bull's, moving with the grace of a swan; enjoying his pleasures in the middle and the end of life; broad of hip, foot, shoulder, knee, face and shank; marked on the flank, face, back and shoulder-hump, of auspicious gait, and patient.

expected.result_summary: High-nosed, dark-eyed, a maker of poetry and skilled in the arts of love, an enjoyer of pleasures; bearing the mark of a fish on the hand, given to the pleasures of sense, quick of intellect, steady; charming, endowed with good fortune, laughter and pleasing speech, ruled by women, long-limbed; he keeps his friendships by night, and is nourished by two mothers.
expected.sanskrit: उन्नासः श्यामचक्षुः सुरतविधिकलाकाव्यकृद्भोगभोगी । हस्ते मत्स्याधिपाङ्को विषयसुखरतो बुद्धिदक्षः स्थिरः । कान्तः सौभाग्यहास्यप्रियवचनयुतः स्त्रीजितो व्यायताङ्गो । याति नैशं सख्यं शशिनि मिथुनगे मातृयुग्मप्रपुष्टः ॥

expected.result_summary: Joined with combinations of good fortune — with home, friends, and a faultless steady knowledge of the star-science; attached to love, grateful, a minister to a ruler, of good measure, much travelled; somewhat frenzied, with fine hair, pleasing to look upon, modest, and followed by elders; delighting in the making of palaces, gardens and tanks, and thick of neck.
expected.sanskrit: युक्तः सौभाग्ययोगैर्गृहसुहृदनवद्यज्योतिषज्ञानधीरैः । कामासक्तः कृतज्ञः क्षितिपतिसचिवः सत्प्रमाणः प्रवासी । सोन्मादः केशकल्पो जनकुसुमरुचिर्ह्रीनिवृद्धानुयातः । प्रासादोद्यानवापीप्रियकरणरतः पीनकण्ठः कुलीरे ॥

expected.result_summary: With a large head and sparse body-hair, broad of face and neck, with a pair of short tawny eyes; hostile to women, afflicted by hunger, thirst, stomach- and tooth-ache, an eater of flesh; a giver, sharp, of few sons, fond of forest and city alike, obedient to his mother, broad-chested; valorous, and of a deep and forceful gaze.
expected.sanskrit: स्थूलशिरा मन्दरोमा पृथुवदनगलो ह्रस्वपिङ्गाक्षियुग्मः । स्त्रीद्वेषी क्षुत्पिपासाजठररदरुजा पीडितो मांसभक्षः । दाता तीक्ष्णोऽल्पपुत्रो विपिननगरतिर्मातृवश्यः सुवक्षाः । विक्रान्तः कालाप्तः … सत्त्ववेगगम्भीरदृष्टिः ॥

expected.result_summary: Fond of women, long-armed, of graceful body and face, with beautiful teeth, eyes and ears; learned, correct in observance, of pleasing speech, with truth and purity foremost in him; steadfast, compassionate towards living beings, drawn to the domains of others, sharing in patience and good fortune; his offspring chiefly daughters, and without many sons.
expected.sanskrit: स्त्रीलोलो लम्बबाहुर्ललिततनुमुखश्चारुदन्ताक्षिकर्णो । विद्वानाचारधर्मी प्रियवचनयुतः सत्यशौचप्रधानः । धीरः सत्त्वानुकम्पी परविषयरतः क्षान्तिसौभाग्यभागी । कन्याप्रायप्रसूतिर्बहुसुतरहितः कन्यकायां शशाङ्के ॥

expected.result_summary: High-nosed, long-eyed, of lean face and body, a lavish giver; pure in the matter of cattle and land, knowing valour, active; devoted to gods and to the twice-born, endowed with much wealth, ruled by women, of slight frame; of many plans concerning grain, and a helper of his kinsfolk.
expected.sanskrit: उन्नासो व्यायताक्षः कृशवदनतनुर्भूरिदायी वृषाय । गोभूभ्यः शौचसारो वृषसमवृषणो विक्रमज्ञः क्रियः । भक्तो देवद्विजानां बहुविभवयुतः स्त्रीजितो हीनदेहः । धान्यादानेकबुद्धिस्तुलिनि … बन्धुवर्गोपकारी ॥

expected.result_summary: Greedy, with rounded thighs and shanks, of very hard body and nose, cruel in his acts; a thief, afflicted by disease in childhood, with damaged chin and nails yet beautiful eyes, and prosperous; occupied with work, very adept, given to other men's wives, without kinsmen, heedless; fierce, his property seized by the king, big-bellied, and firm.
expected.sanskrit: लुब्धो वृत्तोरुजङ्घः कठिनतरतनुर्नासिकः क्रूरचेष्टः । चोरो बाल्ये रुगार्तो हतचिबुकनखश्चारुनेत्रः समृद्धः । कर्मायुक्तः प्रदक्षः परयुवतिरतो बन्धुहीनः प्रमत्तः । चण्डो राज्ञा हतस्वः पृथुजठरः स्थिराः कीटभे शीतरश्मौ ॥

expected.result_summary: Of stooping body, round-eyed, broad of chest and hip, thick-armed, an orator; long-faced, long-necked, dwelling by the water's edge, skilled in craft, keeping his own counsel; brave, well regarded, his substance in wealth, of extended and abundant strength, with thick neck, lips and voice; wearying to his kinsmen, grateful, of close-set feet, and bold.
expected.sanskrit: कुब्जाङ्गो वृत्तनेत्रः पृथुहृदयकटिः पीनबाहुः प्रवक्ता । दीर्घास्यो दीर्घकण्ठो जलतटवसतिः शिल्पविद् गूढगुह्यः । शूरो दृष्टोऽर्थसारो विततबहुबलः स्थूलकण्ठोष्ठवाणो । बन्धुखेदी कृतज्ञो धनुषि शशिधरे संहताङ्घ्रिः प्रगल्भः ॥

expected.result_summary: Knowing song, fearing cold, of a very broad head, a servant of truth and duty; wise, famous, little given to anger, pitiless, having cast off shame; of beautiful eyes and lean body, attached to the women of his elders, a good poet, knowing right conduct; slow in enterprise, much bound to his kinsfolk, long-necked and large-eared.
expected.sanskrit: गीतज्ञः शीतभीरुः पृथुतरशिराः सत्यधर्मोपसेवी । प्राज्ञः ख्यातोऽल्परोषो मनसि भयुतो निर्घृणस्त्यक्तलज्जः । चार्वक्षः क्षामदेहो गुरुयुवतिरतः सत्कविर्वृत्तज्ञो । मन्दोत्साहोऽतिबन्धुः शशिनि मकरगे दीर्घकण्ठोऽतिकर्णः ॥

expected.result_summary: Of rough body, broad of hand and foot, addicted to drink; hated by the good, wanting in virtue, of thick head and poor eyes; overcome by night-time sloth, of wide face and hips, possessed of craft-learning; ill-natured, scorched by sorrow, and poor.
expected.sanskrit: द्रोणो रूक्षदेहः पृथुकरचरणो मद्यपानप्रसक्तः । सद्द्वेष्यो धर्महीनः … स्थूलमूर्धा कुनेत्रः । रात्र्यालस्याभिभूतो विपुलमुखकटिः शिल्पविद्यासमेतो । दुःशीलो दुःखतप्तो घटमुपगते रात्रिनाथे दरिद्रः ॥

expected.result_summary: In matters that go beyond mere craft, skilled at securing benefit and victory, versed in the sastras, of handsome body; knowing song, firm in duty, fond of many women, gentle, a servant of kings; slightly wrathful, of great standing, holding a treasury of comfort and wealth, ruled by women, of good nature; fond of the forest and the sea, and liberal in giving.

expected.result_summary: An army commander, fierce, provided with men, women, sons, wealth and vehicles — a man of the highest kind.

expected.result_summary: Joined with women and wealth, though diseased, a servant of young women, knowing the rites of love, and wise.

expected.result_summary: Thin of hair, slow to act, wrathful, fierce and lofty, proud, diseased in the eye, brave, impatient and pitiless. In Cancer or Aries his eyes are inflamed; in Leo he is dim-sighted and night-blind; born in Libra he is stricken with poverty and his sons perish.

expected.result_summary: Possessing bipeds and quadrupeds, diseased in the mouth, his wealth and comfort destroyed, and his substance plundered by kings and by thieves.

expected.result_summary: Valorous and strong, his siblings destroyed; approved in the world, pleasing, and conquering the king's hostile party.

expected.result_summary: Without vehicles or kinsmen, pained at heart, a destroyer of his father's house and wealth, and a servant of a bad king.

expected.result_summary: Without comfort, sons or wealth, a servant of ploughing, of hills and of fastnesses, fickle; intelligent yet penniless, and short-lived.
expected.sanskrit: सुखसुतवित्तविहीनः कर्षणगिरिदुर्गसेवकश्चपलः । मेधावी धनरहितः स्वल्पायुः पञ्चमे तपने ॥

expected.result_summary: Of powerful passion and digestive fire, strong, prosperous, of famed qualities, a king or a commander of punishment.
expected.sanskrit: प्रबलमदनोदराग्निर्बलवान् षष्ठं समाश्रिते भानौ । श्रीमान् विख्यातगुणो नृपतिर्वा दण्डनेता वा ॥

expected.result_summary: Without prosperity, humiliated, of poor body and diseased, tormented by the king's bonds, given to wrong ways, and hostile to women.
expected.sanskrit: निःश्रीकः परिभूतः कुशरीरो व्याधितः पुमान् द्यूने । नृपबन्धनसन्तप्तोऽमार्गरतो युवतिविद्वेषी ॥

expected.result_summary: Of impaired eyes, without wealth or comfort, short of life, and scorched by separation from those he loves.
expected.sanskrit: विकलनयनोऽष्टमस्थे धनसुखहीनोऽल्पजीवितः पुरुषः । भवति सहस्रमयूखे स्वाभिमतजनविरहसन्तप्तः ॥

expected.result_summary: Having wealth, sons and friends, greatly devoted to the worship of gods and of the twice-born, but hostile to his father's wife.
expected.sanskrit: धनपुत्रमित्रभागी द्विजदेवतपूजनेऽतिरक्तश्च । पितृयोषिद्विद्वेषी नवमे तपने सुतः स्यात् ॥

expected.result_summary: Of great intellect, wealth and strength, with money, vehicles, kinsmen and sons; successful in what he begins, brave, unassailable and praiseworthy.
expected.sanskrit: अतिमतिरतिविभवबलो धनवाहनबन्धुपुत्रवान् सूरे । सिद्धारम्भः शूरो दशमेऽधृष्यः प्रशस्यश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: Given to hoarding, strong, disliked, himself a servant yet with obedient servants; compliant, without those dear to him, and successful in what he does.
expected.sanskrit: सञ्चयनिरतो बलवान् द्वेष्यः प्रेष्यो विधेयभृत्यश्च । एकादशे विधेयः प्रियरहितः सिद्धकर्मा च ॥

expected.result_summary: Of crippled body, one-eyed, fallen, the husband of a barren woman, an enemy to his father, without strength, and mean.
expected.sanskrit: विकलशरीरः काणः पतितो वन्ध्यापतिः पितुरमित्रः । द्वादशस्थे सूर्ये बलरहितो जायते क्षुद्रः ॥

expected.result_summary: Foremost in courtesy, beauty, wealth, enjoyment and quality, when the Moon in the lagna stands in Cancer, Taurus or Aries; in the remaining signs the man is frenzied, low, deaf, deformed and mute, and especially of dark body.
expected.sanskrit: दाक्षिण्यरूपधनभोगगुणैः प्रधानः चन्द्रे कुलीरवृषभाजगते विलग्ने । उन्मत्तनीचबधिरो विकटश्च मूको शेषे नरो भवति कृष्णतनुर्विशेषात् ॥

expected.result_summary: Provided with unpolished comfort, riches and wealth; and if the Moon be full, very generous with money and sparing of speech.
expected.sanskrit: अललितसुखविभवयुतो धनैश्च चन्द्रे द्वितीयराशिगते । सम्पूर्णेऽतिधनदो भवति नरोऽल्पप्रलापकरः ॥

expected.result_summary: A refuge for his brothers, joyful when the Moon there is strong, brave, and given to gathering learning, garments and food.
expected.sanskrit: भ्रातृजनाश्रयणीयो मुदान्वितः सहजगे बलिनि । चन्द्रे भवति च शूरो विद्यावस्त्रान्नसङ्ग्रहणशीलः ॥

expected.result_summary: With kinsmen, appointments and vehicles, a giver, fond of moving about, and released from the extremes of pleasure and pain.
expected.sanskrit: बन्धुपरिच्छदवाहनसहितो दाता चतुर्थगे चन्द्रे । अलसंचारानुरतः सुखासुखोत्कर्षपरिमुक्तः ॥

expected.result_summary: Not brave, but given to gathering learning, garments and food; with many sons and gentle friends, intelligent and sharp.
expected.sanskrit: चन्द्रे भवति न शूरो विद्यावस्त्रान्नसङ्ग्रहणशीलः । बहुतनयसौम्यमित्रो मेधावी पञ्चमे तीक्ष्णः ॥

expected.result_summary: Of many enemies, soft-bodied, proud and indolent, afflicted by diseases of the belly; and if the Moon there be waned, short-lived.
expected.sanskrit: प्रचुरामित्रशीलो मृदुकायाभिमदालसश्चन्द्रे । षष्ठे वृकोदरभवै रोगैः सम्पीडितो भवति । रजनिकरे स्वल्पायुः षष्ठगते भवति संक्षीणे ॥

expected.result_summary: Gentle, assailable, happy, of good body and full of desire; but with a dark Moon his body is afflicted by disease.
expected.sanskrit: सौम्यो धृष्यः सुखितः सुशरीरः कामसंयुतो द्यूने । दन्यरुगर्दितदेहः कृष्णे संजायते शशिनि ॥

expected.result_summary: Of great intellect and great lustre, his body wasted by disease and confinement; and short-lived if the Moon be waned.
expected.sanskrit: अतिमतिरतितेजस्वी व्याधिविबन्धक्षपितदेहः । निधनस्थे रजनिकरे स्वल्पायुर्भवति संक्षीणे ॥

expected.result_summary: Devoted to the works of the gods and the forefathers, endowed with comfort, wealth, intellect and sons, and lovely in the eyes of young women.

expected.result_summary: Free from despondency, devoted to his work, successful in what he begins, abounding in wealth, pure, very strong, brave and a giver.
expected.sanskrit: अविषादी कर्मपरः सिद्धारम्भश्च धनसमृद्धश्च । शुचिरतिबलोऽथ दशमे शूरो दाता भवेच्छशिनि ॥

expected.result_summary: Wealthy, with many sons, long-lived, with a company of friends and servants; high-minded, sharp, brave and illustrious.
expected.sanskrit: धनवान् बहुसुतभागी बह्वायुः सुहृद्भृत्यवर्गश्च । इन्दौ भवेन्मनस्वी तीक्ष्णः शूरः प्रकाशश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: Hated, fallen, mean, afflicted with eye disease, indolent and crippled; of doubtful parentage, and constantly humiliated.
expected.sanskrit: द्वेष्यः पतितः क्षुद्रो नयनरुगार्तोऽलसो भवेद्विकलः । चन्द्रे तथान्यजातो द्वादशगे नित्यपरिभूतः ॥

expected.result_summary: Cruel, given to daring, agitated, short-lived, holding his own honour and valour, of scarred yet good body, and fickle.
expected.sanskrit: क्रूरः साहसनिरतः सुब्धोऽल्पायुः स्वमानशौर्ययुतः । क्षतगात्रः सुशरीरो वक्रे लग्नाश्रिते चपलः ॥

expected.result_summary: Poor, content with bad food, of deformed face, a resort of bad men, and destitute of learning.
expected.sanskrit: अधनः कदशनतुष्टः पुरुषो विकृताननो धनस्थाने । कुजनाश्रयश्च रुधिरे भवति नरो विद्यया रहितः ॥

expected.result_summary: Brave, unassailable, separated from his mother, joyful, a vessel of every quality, and famous.
expected.sanskrit: शूरो भवत्यधृष्यो मातृवियुक्तो मुदान्वितः पुरुषः । भूपुत्रे सहजस्थे समस्तगुणभाजनं ख्यातः ॥

expected.result_summary: Without kinsmen, appointments or vehicles, scorched by great sorrows, and dwelling in the houses of others.
expected.sanskrit: बन्धुपरिच्छदरहितो भवति चतुर्थेऽथ वाहनविहीनः । अतिदुःखैः सन्तप्तः परगृहवासी कुजे पुरुषः ॥

expected.result_summary: Gentle in wealth, sons and friends, yet fickle of mind; a slanderer, full of misfortune, diseased, crippled and low.
expected.sanskrit: सौम्यार्थपुत्रमित्रश्चलमतिरपि पञ्चमे कुजे भवति । पिशुनोऽनर्थप्रायः सरुग्विकलो नरो नीचः ॥

expected.result_summary: Of powerful passion and digestive fire, of good and long body, strong, victorious over his own kinsmen, and a chief.
expected.sanskrit: प्रबलमदनोदराग्निः सुशरीरो व्यायतो बली षष्ठे । रुधिरे सम्भवति नरः स्वबन्धुविजयी प्रधानश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: His wife dies; afflicted with disease, given to wrong ways, sorrowful and sinful, without prosperity, tormented, and of withered body.
expected.sanskrit: मृतदारो रोगार्तोऽमार्गरतो भवति दुःखितः पापः । श्रीरहितः सन्तप्तः शुष्कतनुर्भवति सप्तमे भौमे ॥

expected.result_summary: Mostly diseased, short-lived, of poor body, doing low work, and scorched by grief.
expected.sanskrit: व्याधिप्रायोऽल्पायुः कुशरीरो नीचकर्मकृतश्च । निधनस्थे क्षितितनये भवति पुमान् शोकसन्तप्तः ॥

expected.result_summary: Unskilful in his work, hated, given to the killing of living beings, without duty and very sinful, yet honoured by the king.
expected.sanskrit: अकुशलकर्मा द्वेष्यः प्राणिवधपरो भवेन्नवमसंस्थे । धर्मरहितोऽतिपापो नरेन्द्रकृतगौरवो रुधिरे ॥

expected.result_summary: Engaged in work, brave, assailable, serving the chief men, with sons and comfort, and of abundant majesty.
expected.sanskrit: कर्मायुक्तो दशमे शूरो धृष्यः प्रधानजनसेवी । सुतसौख्ययुतो रुधिरे प्रतापबहुलः पुमान् भवति ॥

expected.result_summary: Wealthy, sharing in the pleasures he loves, brave, with wealth, grain and sons, and free from grief.
expected.sanskrit: एकादशगे धनवान् प्रियसुखभागी तथा भवेच्छूरः । धनधान्यसुतैः सहितः क्षितितनये विगतशोकश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: Of disordered eyes, fallen, a killer of his wife, a tale-bearer and terrible; humiliated, and he comes to bondage.
expected.sanskrit: नयनविकारी पतितो जायाघ्नः सूचकश्च रौद्रः । द्वादशगे परिभूतो बन्धनमाप्नोति भूपुत्रे ॥

expected.result_summary: Of unimpaired body and intellect, knowing countries, arts, learning, poetry and calculation; of very sweet and clever speech, and long-lived.
expected.sanskrit: अनुपहतदेहबुद्धिर्देशकलाज्ञानकाव्यगणितज्ञः । अतिमधुरचतुरवाक्यो दीर्घायुः स्याद्बुधे लग्ने ॥

expected.result_summary: His wealth earned by intellect, an enjoyer of food and drink, of splendid speech and good policy.
expected.sanskrit: बुद्ध्योपार्जितविभवो धनभवनगतेऽन्नपानभोगी च । शोभनवाक्यः सुनयः शशितनये मानवो भवति ॥

expected.result_summary: Given to toil, diminished, adept, attended by siblings, full of illusion, and unsteady.
expected.sanskrit: श्रमनिरतः परिहीनस्तृतीयराशौ बुधे भवति जातः । निपुणः सहजसमेतो मायाबहुलो नरश्चलितः ॥

expected.result_summary: They call him learned: fortunate, provided with vehicles and appointments, of good kin, and always a scholar.
expected.sanskrit: पण्डितमाहुः सुभगो वाहनयुक्तो बुधे हिबुकसंस्थे । सपरिच्छदः सुबन्धुर्भवति नरः पण्डितो नित्यम् ॥

expected.result_summary: Skilled in mantra and in incantation, with many sons, endowed with learning, comfort and power, and full of pride.
expected.sanskrit: मन्त्राभिचारकुशलो बहुतनयः पञ्चमे सौम्ये । विद्यासुखप्रभावैः समन्वितो दर्पसंयुक्तः ॥

expected.result_summary: Defeated in argument, dispute and quarrel, diseased, indolent, his anger spent, harsh of speech, and greatly humiliated.
expected.sanskrit: वादविवादे कलहे निर्जितो व्याधितो बुधे षष्ठे । अलसो विनष्टकोपो निष्ठुरवाक्योऽतिपरिभूतः ॥

expected.result_summary: He obtains a wife of prosperity and very fine appearance, not of high family and quarrelsome, of much wealth; and he obtains greatness.
expected.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीं सुचारुवेषां नातिकुलीनां च कलहशीलां च । भार्यामनेकवित्तां द्यूने लभते महत्त्वं च ॥

expected.result_summary: Of famous name and substance, of steady life, holding a household; the equal of a king, or else a commander of punishment.
expected.sanskrit: विख्यातनामसारः स्थिरजीवी कुटधरो निधनसंस्थे । शशितनये भवति नरो नृपतिसमो दण्डनायको वापि ॥

expected.result_summary: Endowed with great wealth and learning, of auspicious conduct, a lord of speech, very adept, and most righteous.
expected.sanskrit: नवमगते भवति पुमानतिधनविद्यायुतः शुभाचारः । वागीश्वरोऽतिनिपुणो धर्मिष्ठः सोमपुत्रे हि ॥

expected.result_summary: Of excellent mind and action, successful in what he begins, accomplished, steadfast, courageous, and possessing ornaments of many kinds.
expected.sanskrit: प्रवरमतिकर्मचेष्टः सफलारम्भो विशारदो दशमे । धीरः सत्त्वसमेतो विविधालङ्कारसत्त्वभाक् सौम्ये ॥

expected.result_summary: Wealthy, with obedient servants, wise, comfortable, of ample enjoyment, long-lived and renowned.
expected.sanskrit: धनवान् विधेयभृत्यः प्राज्ञः सौख्यान्वितो विपुलभोगी । एकादशे बुधे स्याद्दीर्घायुः ख्यातिमान् पुरुषः ॥

expected.result_summary: His word well received, yet indolent and humiliated; eloquent and wise, but wretched and cruel.
expected.sanskrit: सुगृहीतवाक्यमलसं परिभूतं वाग्मिनं तथा प्राज्ञम् । व्ययगः करोति सौम्यः पुरुषं दीनं नृशंसं च ॥

expected.result_summary: Of good body, full of vitality, very long-lived, doing his work after due consideration, wise, steadfast and noble.
expected.sanskrit: होरासंस्थे जीवे सुशरीरः प्राणवान् सुदीर्घायुः । सुसमीक्षितकार्यकरः प्राज्ञो धीरस्तथार्यश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: Wealthy, of substantial food, eloquent, of fine body, fine speech and fine mouth; of auspicious form, generous, and of a pleasing face.
expected.sanskrit: धनवान् भोजनसारो वाग्मी सुवपुः सुवाक् सुवक्त्रश्च । कल्याणवपुस्त्यागी सुमुखो जीवे भवेद्धनगे ॥

expected.result_summary: Greatly humiliated, miserly, always defeated, of short life, mastered by women, and a doer of evil.
expected.sanskrit: अतिपरिभूतः कृपणः सदाजितो मानवो भवति जीवे । मन्दायुः स्त्रीविजितो दुश्चिक्ये पापकर्मा च ॥

expected.result_summary: Provided with his own people, appointments, vehicles, comfort, intellect, enjoyment and wealth; foremost, and grieved at what he hears.
expected.sanskrit: स्वजनपरिच्छदवाहनसुखमतिभोगार्थसंयुतो भवति । श्रेष्ठः श्रुतविषादी चतुर्थसंस्थे सदा जीवे ॥

expected.result_summary: Happy, rich in friends, wise, firm, of substantial wealth, and happy in every quarter.
expected.sanskrit: सुखयुतमित्रसमृद्धः प्राज्ञो धृतिमांस्तथा विभवसारः । पञ्चमभवने जीवे सर्वत्र सुखी भवति जातः ॥

expected.result_summary: Of failing digestion and virility, humiliated, weak and indolent, hostile to women, yet a slayer of his enemies and very famous.
expected.sanskrit: सन्नोदराग्निपुंस्त्वः परिभूतो दुर्बलोऽलसः षष्ठे । स्त्रीषु द्वेषी रिपुहन्ता जीवे पुरुषोऽतिविख्यातः ॥

expected.result_summary: Fortunate, pleasing, generous, greater than his father; an orator, a poet, a chief, wise and well renowned.
expected.sanskrit: सुभगः सुरुचिरुदारः पितुरधिकः सप्तमे भवति जातः । वक्ता कविः प्रधानः प्राज्ञो जीवे सुविख्यातः ॥

expected.result_summary: Humiliated, long-lived, a hireling or a bondsman, an errand-man of his own people, wretched, and enjoying unclean women.
expected.sanskrit: परिभूतो दीर्घायुर्भृतको दासोऽथवा निधनसंस्थे । स्वजनप्रेष्यो दीनो मलिनस्त्रीभोगवान् जीवे ॥

expected.result_summary: Devoted to the works of gods and forefathers, learned, fortunate, a king's minister or a leader, and a chief.
expected.sanskrit: देवतपितृकार्यरतो विद्वान् सुभगो भवेत्तथा नवमे । नृपमन्त्री नेता वा जीवे जातः प्रधानश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: Successful in what he begins, honoured, skilled and prosperous in every expedient, and joined with comfort, wealth, people and vehicles.
expected.sanskrit: सिद्धारम्भो मान्यः सर्वोपायकुशलसमृद्धश्च । दशमस्थे त्रिदशगुरौ सुखधनजनवाहनयोगभाक् ॥

expected.result_summary: With unbounded sources of income, with many vehicles and servants, and virtuous; but neither very learned nor with many sons.
expected.sanskrit: अपरिमितायद्वारो बहुवाहनभृत्यसंयुतः साधुः । एकादशमे जीवे न चातिविद्यो न चातिसुतः ॥

expected.result_summary: Indolent, hated by the world, deprived of speech or fallen from the side of the gods; humiliated, and given to service.
expected.sanskrit: अलसो लोकद्वेष्यो ह्यपगतवाग्दैवपक्षभ्रष्टो वा । परिभूतः सेवानिरतो द्वादशसंस्थे गुरौ भवति ॥

expected.result_summary: Of fine eyes, face and body, happy, long-lived and steadfast, and lovely in the eyes of young women.
expected.sanskrit: सुनयनवदनशरीरं सुखितं दीर्घायुषं तथा धीरम् । युवतिजननयनकान्तं जनयति होरागतः शुक्रः ॥

expected.result_summary: With abundant food, drink and wealth, of excellent elegance, of good speech, and possessed of much money.
expected.sanskrit: प्रचुरान्नपानविभवं श्रेष्ठविलासं तथा सुवाक्यं च । कुरुते द्वितीयराशौ बहुधनसहितं सितः पुरुषम् ॥

expected.result_summary: With comfort and wealth, yet ruled by women and miserly; slow in enterprise, and passed over in good fortune and appointments.
expected.sanskrit: सुखधनसहितं शुक्रो दुश्चिक्ये स्त्रीजितं तथा कृपणम् । जनयति मन्दोत्साहं सौभाग्यपरिच्छदातीतम् ॥

expected.result_summary: With kinsmen, friends and comfort, charming, rich in vehicles and appointments, graceful, not wretched, and fortunate.
expected.sanskrit: बन्धुसुहृत्सुखसहितं कान्तं वाहनपरिच्छदसमृद्धम् । ललितमदीनं सुभगं जनयति हिबुके नरं शुक्रः ॥

expected.result_summary: Increased in comfort, sons and friends, very amorous, very wealthy and unbroken; a minister or a commander of punishment.
expected.sanskrit: सुखसुतमित्रोपचितं रतिपरमतिधनमखण्डितं शुक्रः । कुरुते पञ्चमराशौ मन्त्रिणमथ दण्डनेतारम् ॥

expected.result_summary: Much disliked by women, with many enemies, rejected by wealth, crippled, and very low.
expected.sanskrit: अधिकमनिष्टं स्त्रीणां प्रचुरामित्रं निराकृतं विभवैः । विकलमतीव नीचं कुरुते षष्ठे भृगोस्तनयः ॥

expected.result_summary: With a wife of great beauty and with comfort, of many forms, free from quarrel, and endowed with good fortune.
expected.sanskrit: अतिरूपदारसौख्यं बहुरूपं कलहवर्जितं पुरुषम् । जनयति सप्तमधाम्नि सौभाग्यसमन्वितं शुक्रः ॥

expected.result_summary: Long-lived, of scant comfort but abounding in wealth; the equal of a king, and finding satisfaction moment by moment.
expected.sanskrit: दीर्घायुरवमसुखः शुक्रे निधनाश्रिते धनसमृद्धः । भवति पुमान् नृपतिसमः क्षणे क्षणे लब्धपरितोषः ॥

expected.result_summary: Of well-proportioned body and wealth, provided with wife, young women, comfort and friends, and attached to gods, guests and elders.
expected.sanskrit: समायततनुवित्तो दारयुवतिसुखसुहृज्जनोपेतः । भृगुतनये नवमस्थे सुरातिथिगुरुप्रसक्तः स्यात् ॥

expected.result_summary: One whose comfort, love, honour, wealth and fame are won by exertion and by contention; a man of much intellect and renown.
expected.sanskrit: उत्थानविवादजिताः सुखरतिमानार्थकीर्तयो यस्य । दशमे भृगुतनये भवति पुमान् बहुमतिख्यातः ॥

expected.result_summary: Attended by handsome servants, of much nobility, and but little scorched by grief.
expected.sanskrit: प्रतिरूपदासाश्रयं बह्वार्यं स्वल्पशोकसन्तप्तम् । जनयति लाभभवनगतो भृगुतनयः सर्वदा पुरुषम् ॥

expected.result_summary: Indolent, comfortable, stout, fallen, an eater of dainties, skilled in the service of the bed, and ruled by women.
expected.sanskrit: अलसं सुखिनं स्थूलं पतितं मृष्टाशिनं भृगोस्तनयः । शयनोपचारकुशलं द्वादशगः स्त्रीजितं जनयेत् ॥

expected.result_summary: In its exaltation or its own rasi in the lagna, the equal of a ruler of the earth and a lord of country and city; in the remaining rasis, afflicted with sorrow and disease in childhood, subject to servile work, unclean and indolent.
expected.sanskrit: स्वोच्चस्वकीयभवने क्षितिपालतुल्यो लग्नेऽर्कजे भवति देशपुराधिनाथः । शेषेषु दुःखगदपीडित एव बाल्ये दास्यिककर्मवशगो मलिनोऽलसश्च ॥

expected.result_summary: Of deformed face, an enjoyer of wealth, without people about him, acting justly; afterwards going to another country, and provided with people, vehicles and enjoyment.
expected.sanskrit: विकृतवदनोऽर्थभोक्ता जनरहितो न्यायकृत् कुटुम्बगते । पश्चात्परदेशगतो जनवाहनभोगवान् सौरे ॥

expected.result_summary: Unclean though of well-kept body, low, with indolent attendants; brave, given to giving, and of ample intellect.
expected.sanskrit: मलिनः संस्कृतदेहो नीचोऽलसपरिजनो भवति सौरे । शूरो दानानुरतो दुश्चिक्यगते विपुलबुद्धिः ॥

expected.result_summary: Pained at heart, without kinsmen, vehicles, wealth, intellect or comfort; his body diseased in childhood, and wearing long nails and hair.
expected.sanskrit: पीडितहृदयो हिबुके निर्बान्धववाहनार्थमतिसौख्यः । बाल्ये व्याधितदेहो नखरोमधरो भवेत् सौरे ॥

expected.result_summary: Without comfort, sons or friends, without intellect or sense, somewhat frenzied, and always wretched.
expected.sanskrit: सुखसुतमित्रविहीनं मतिरहितमचेतसं त्रिकोणस्थः । सोन्मादं रवितनयः करोति पुरुषं सदा दीनम् ॥

expected.result_summary: Of powerful passion, of good body, brave, a great eater, of uneven character, and worn down by the party of his many enemies.
expected.sanskrit: प्रबलमदनं सुदेहं शूरं बह्वाशिनं विषमशीलम् । बहुरिपुपक्षक्षपितं रिपुभवनगतोऽर्कजः कुरुते ॥

expected.result_summary: Of constantly unhealthy body, his wife dead, deprived of wealth, ill-clad, sinful, and doing much low work.
expected.sanskrit: सततमनारोग्यतनुं मृतदारं धनविवर्जितं जनयेत् । द्यूनेऽर्कजः कुवेषं पापं बहुनीचकर्माणम् ॥

expected.result_summary: Scorched by leprosy and by fistula, of short life, and destitute of all enterprise.
expected.sanskrit: कुष्ठभगन्दरयोगैरभितप्तं ह्रस्वजीवितं निधने । सर्वारम्भविहीनं जनयति रविजः सदा पुरुषम् ॥

expected.result_summary: Without duty, of little wealth, without siblings or sons, without comfort, and a tormentor of others.
expected.sanskrit: धर्मरहितोऽल्पधनिकः सहजसुतविवर्जितो नवमसंस्थे । रविजे सौख्यविहीनः परोपतापी च जायते मनुजः ॥

expected.result_summary: Wealthy, wise and brave; a minister or a commander of punishment, and a leader of companies, towns and villages.
expected.sanskrit: धनवान् प्राज्ञः शूरो मन्त्री वा दण्डनायको वापि । दशमस्थे रवितनये वृन्दपुरग्रामनेता च ॥

expected.result_summary: Long-lived, of stable wealth, brave, resorting to craft, free from disease, and endowed with wealth and people.
expected.sanskrit: बह्वायुः स्थिरविभवः शूरः शिल्पाश्रयो विगतरोगः । आयस्थे भानुसुते धनजनसम्पद्युतो भवति ॥

expected.result_summary: Deformed, fallen, foolish, of uneven eyes, pitiless and shameless; of great expenditure, and much humiliated.
expected.sanskrit: विकटः पतितो मूर्खो विषमाक्षो निर्घृणो विगतलज्जः । व्ययभवनगते सौरे बहुव्ययः स्यात् सुपरिभूतः ॥

expected.result_summary: Malefics strike down at the root the bhavas they occupy, and benefics nourish them; in the sixth, eighth and twelfth the rule is reversed, and the good and bad results are exchanged.
expected.sanskrit: पापा निघ्नन्ति मूलमादीन् भावान् पुष्णन्ति शोभनाः । विपरीतं रिपुरन्ध्रव्ययेषु सदसत्फलम् ॥

expected.result_summary: By the yogas, by combinations of strength, by the aspect of benefics and of friends, and by grahas standing in exaltation and the like, the result becomes otherwise.
expected.sanskrit: योगा ये बलयोगाः सौम्यसुहृद्विपुनिरीक्षणं चैव । उच्चादिभवनसंस्थैर्ग्रहैश्च फलमन्यथा भवति ॥

expected.result_summary: In the Sun's dasha he finds his pleasure through new medicines, land, poison, discomfort and loss; through hills and fastnesses, wandering, fire, wrath, kings and the spoils of battle. He gains wealth from the king, renewed exertion and keenness, fame, a growth of majesty, pre-eminence, and kingship.
expected.sanskrit: भानुदशायां रमते नवौषधाद्भूविषदौस्थ्यनैरथ्यात् । गिरिदुर्गान्तचरवह्निक्रोधनरेन्द्राहवार्यैश्च ॥ नृपतेरर्थाप्तिं … ख्यातिं प्रतापवृद्धिं श्रेष्ठत्वं भूपतिं च ॥

expected.result_summary: In the Moon's dasha, wealth through union with women and through fate; sport with water, snow, milk, juices and preparations of sugar-cane; the winning of brahmins and of mantras, the use of flowers and garments, and sweetness; success won by keenness, and honour from elders and kings. A good Moon-dasha always makes for intellect, firmness and nourishment.
expected.sanskrit: चन्द्रदशायां वित्तं स्त्रीसंगमादैवात् … जलतुहिनक्षीररसैरिक्षुविकारैस्तथा क्रीडा ॥ द्विजमन्त्राणां लब्धिः पुष्पाम्बरसेवनं मधुरता च ॥ तैक्ष्ण्यादवाप्तसिद्धिः पूजां प्राप्नोति गुरुनृपाभ्यां च । मेधाधृतिपुष्टिकरी चन्द्रदशा शोभना नित्यम् ॥

expected.result_summary: In Mars's dasha he obtains the crushing of enemies through kings, claimants and thieves, and wealth by cruel means — through snakes, poison, weapons and bondage; and he comes to wealth and grain through land, goats and sheep, weaving, gold and subjugation, and through fermented, astringent and pungent tastes.
expected.sanskrit: भौमदशायां लभते नृपार्थिचोरप्रयोगरिपुमर्दः । व्यालविषशस्त्रबन्धनयुतैः क्रूरैरर्थं धनलाभम् ॥ क्षियाजाविकतन्त्रिकसुवर्णवश्यादिभिस्तथा … आसवकषायकटुकै रसैर्धनधान्यभाग्भवति ॥

expected.result_summary: In Mercury's dasha, gain of wealth from a rich friend, from a consecrated king, from gambling and from merchants; mules, land, gold and pearl-shell goods, glory and praise; embassy, matchless comfort, good fortune, and fame for gathered intellect; religious acts that bear fruit, love of the sastras, and the wasting away of enemies. He is always delighted with calculation, drawing and writing.
expected.sanskrit: सौम्यदशायां प्राप्तिर्मित्रादाढ्याद्धनस्य सम्प्राप्तिः । दीक्षितनृपतेर्द्यूताद्वणिग्जनाच्चापि सम्भवति ॥ वेसरमहीसुवर्णं शुक्तिद्रव्यं यशः प्रशंसा च । दूत्यं सौख्यमतुल्यं सौभाग्यं मतिचयख्यातिः ॥ धर्मक्रिया सिद्धिदा शास्त्ररतिः शत्रुसंक्षयो भवति ॥

expected.result_summary: In Jupiter's dasha, ministership, and wealth through kings and statecraft; the gaining of honour and of qualities, great majesty, and increase of friends. He is ever an enjoyer of women, gold, mules, elephants and horses; he gains auspicious and strengthening things and the destruction of his enemies; and he gains men, and friendship with good men and with kings, wealth from the people, from the king's own mouth, from prime merchandise and from travel.
expected.sanskrit: त्रिदशपतिगुरुदशायां मन्त्री नृपनृपनीतिभिर्वित्तम् । मानगुणानां लब्धिरतिप्रतापः सुहृद्वृद्धिः ॥ कान्तासुवर्णवेसरगजाश्वभोगी सदा पुरुषः । माङ्गल्यपौष्टिकानां लाभो द्विषतां विनाशश्च ॥ लाभो भवति … प्रीतिः सद्भिर्नृपैः सार्धम् ॥

expected.result_summary: In Venus's dasha, victory, and the winning of land, houses, elegance, beds and wives; garlands, clothing, food, glory, delight, and the finding of treasure; love of song, union with women, and gain of wealth from the king and from agriculture; knowledge, the comforts he desires, friends, and the fit instruments of love.
expected.sanskrit: शुक्रदशायां विजयः क्ष्माभवनविलासशयनपत्नीनाम् । माल्याच्छादनभोजनयशःप्रमोदो निधिप्राप्तिः ॥ गेयरतिः स्त्रीसङ्गो नृपतेः कृषितो धनस्य सम्प्राप्तिः । ज्ञानेष्टसौख्यसुहृदां मन्मथयोग्योपकरणानाम् ॥

expected.result_summary: In Saturn's dasha a man obtains donkeys, camels, buffaloes and the like; an ill-favoured or aged wife; horse-gram, sesame, kodrava and such grains; office and honour over companies, villages and towns; iron, tolls and the like; and a firm station within his own party.
expected.sanskrit: सौरे प्रपन्नः प्राप्नोति पुमान् खरोष्ट्रमहिषादीन् । कुरूपां जरदङ्गीं वा कुलुत्थतिलकोद्रवादींश्च ॥ वृन्दग्रामपुराणामधिकारभवं च सत्कारम् । लोहशुल्कादीनां स्वकीयपक्षस्थिरास्पदं चैव ॥

expected.result_summary: When the Sun's dasha is unfavourable: harm from roots, from wealth, thieves, snakes, wounds, weapons, water and rulers; oppression by sons, wife and kinsmen, and a leaning to sin; hunger, thirst and pain, grief, toothache, bilious diseases, and the severing of a limb.
expected.sanskrit: मूलार्थचोरसर्पक्षतशस्त्रोदकक्षितीशबाधाद्याः । सुतपत्नीबन्धुजनैर्निपीडितः स्याच्च पापरतिः ॥ क्षुत्तृष्णार्तिः शोको दन्तपीडा पैत्तिकास्तथा रोगाः । गात्रच्छेदो भवति हि सूर्यदशायामनिष्टायाम् ॥

expected.result_summary: The Moon's dasha also brings death in the family and painful strife within one's own line; sleep and sloth, fear on account of women, grief, and pleasure; and sudden loss of wealth and hatred in the king's assembly.
expected.sanskrit: कुरुते मृत्युं कुलस्य च चन्द्रदशा स्वकुलविग्रहं कष्टम् । निद्रालस्यं स्त्रीणां भयजननी शोकदा रतिदा ॥ अर्थविनाशमकस्मात् भूपसदो द्वेष्यतां लभते ॥

expected.result_summary: Conflict with friends and wife, strife with brothers, and thirst; fainting, disorders of the blood, the cutting of a limb, and wounds; attachment to other men's wives, hatefulness, unrighteousness towards elders and towards truth, and being overwhelmed by the faults his father committed.
expected.sanskrit: मित्रकलत्रविरोधो भ्रातृयुतैर्विग्रहश्च तृष्णा च । मूर्च्छा शोणितदोषः शाखाच्छेदो व्रणश्चापि ॥ परदाररतिर्द्वेष्यो गुरुसत्यानामधर्मनिरतश्च । पितृकृतैरपि दोषैरभिभूतो मानवो भवति ॥

expected.result_summary: A cruel Mercury-dasha gives affliction from the three humours, harshness, bondage, agitation, and grief of mind.
expected.sanskrit: पीडां धातुत्रितयात् पारुष्यं बन्धनं तथोद्वेगम् । मानसशोकं वापि बुधस्य क्रूरा दशा कुरुते ॥

expected.result_summary: Wasting of the body, great grief, lameness, tumours and diseases of the ear; loss of virility, wasting of the flesh, and fear from the king.
expected.sanskrit: गात्रक्षयं पृथुशोकं पङ्गुत्वं गुल्मकर्णरोगांश्च । पुंस्त्वविनाशं मेदःक्षयं नृपतितो भयं समाप्नोति ॥

expected.result_summary: Disputes about the increase of family standing; sins arising out of vehicles and seats; and, inevitably through women and kings, close friendship with those whom the world opposes.
expected.sanskrit: कुलगुणवृद्धेर्वादो यानासनसंभवानि पापानि । स्त्रीनृपतिकृतावश्यं लोकविरुद्धैः सद्भ्रीतिः ॥

expected.result_summary: Loss of vehicles, agitation and discontent, separation from wife and kinsmen, the fault of defeat in battle, and disorders of wind; failure in meritorious acts, quarrel, bondage, torpor, toil and deformity, and conflict with servants and children, when Saturn's dasha is a hard one.
expected.sanskrit: वाहननाशोद्वेगस्त्वरतिः स्त्रीस्वजनविप्रयोगश्च । युद्धेष्वपजयदोषो … मरुत्कोपः ॥ पुण्येष्वसिद्धिः कलहं बन्धनतन्द्रीश्रमं तथाव्यङ्गम् । भृत्यापत्यविरोधो भवति च कष्टं यदा दशा सौरेः ॥

expected.result_summary: Grahas standing in exaltation, in their own rasi, in their own or a friend's navamsha, full of strength and beauty in their own period, joined with the navamsha of a friend or of exaltation and aspected by benefics, bring about an excellent dasha.
expected.sanskrit: स्वोच्चस्वराशिनिजभागसुहृत्स्थाः सम्पूर्णवीर्यरुचिरा बलिनः स्वकाले । मित्रोच्चभागसहिताः शुभदृष्टियुक्ताः श्रेष्ठां दशां विदधति ॥

expected.result_summary: Grahas that have reached debilitation or an enemy's house, standing in an enemy's navamsha, dim of colour and connected with malefics, make the dasha inauspicious.
expected.sanskrit: नीचशत्रुगृहं प्राप्ताः शत्रुनिभांशसंस्थगाः । विवर्णाः पापसंबन्धा दशां कुर्युरशोभनाम् ॥

expected.result_summary: The ripening of a combust graha afflicts only with bondage.
expected.sanskrit: अस्तमितग्रहपाको बन्धनमात्रेण पीडयति

expected.result_summary: The dasha of a retrograde graha whirls a man about like a potter's wheel and brings calamities and enmity — of a malefic, not of a benefic.
expected.sanskrit: वक्रोपगस्य हि दशा भ्रमयति च कुलालचक्रवत्पुरुषम् । व्यसनानि रिपुविरोधं करोति पापस्य न शुभस्य ॥

expected.result_summary: A hard dasha causes calamity, and the dasha of a graha in the eighth causes death.
expected.sanskrit: कष्टदशा व्यसनकरी मरणं च करोति नैधनस्थदशा

expected.result_summary: The dasha of a graha in the sixth rasi brings about the cutting of limbs and members.
expected.sanskrit: अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गानां छेदं विदधाति षष्ठराशिदशा

expected.result_summary: In the dasha of a graha gone to an enemy's rasi: abandonment of one's country, disease, fame rising and falling again and again, quarrels, and bondage caused by enemies.
expected.sanskrit: देशत्यागो व्याधिर्यशोत्थानं मुहुर्मुहुः कलहः । बन्धनमरातिजनितं रिपुराशिगतस्य हि दशायाम् ॥

expected.result_summary: The dasha of a graha in the house of gain, and likewise of one exalted, gives the gaining of a province; of one standing in a kendra, the gaining of wealth, vehicles and country.
expected.sanskrit: लाभग्रहगस्य हि दशा मण्डललाभं तथोच्चगस्यापि । केन्द्रस्थितस्य कुरुते धनवाहनदेशसम्प्राप्तिम् ॥

expected.result_summary: A graha standing in a head-rising rasi gives its result at the beginning of the dasha; in a both-ways-rising rasi, in the middle; and at the end if it is in a back-rising rasi or in its rasi of debilitation.
expected.sanskrit: आदौ दशासु फलदः शीर्षोदयराशिसंस्थितो विहगः । उभयोदये च मध्ये स्यादन्ते पृष्ठोदये च नीचर्क्षे ॥

expected.result_summary: In the Moon's mula-dasha with the Moon in Virgo, the Yavanas here declare constant intercourse with women for hire.
expected.sanskrit: मूलदशायामिन्दोः कन्यासु … चन्द्रे । पण्याङ्गनाभिरनिशं समागमं प्राहुरिह यवनाः ॥

expected.result_summary: With the Moon in Cancer, at the beginning of the dasha, the gain of a gentle wife and of wealth.
expected.sanskrit: सौम्यस्त्रीधनलाभः कुलीरगेन्दौ भवेद्दशारम्भे

expected.result_summary: In a house of Mars the man violates a maiden, or kills a young woman.

expected.result_summary: In a rasi of Venus, incomparable food, drink and comfort.

expected.result_summary: In Leo the Moon commends dwelling in fastnesses and forests, ploughing, house-work and the building of causeways; and it gives disputes with wife and sons, and discontent.
expected.sanskrit: दुर्गारण्यनिवासं कर्षणगृहकर्मसेतुकर्मान्तम् । सिंहे शशी प्रशंसते स्त्रीपुत्रविवादमरतिं च ॥

expected.result_summary: Conjunction with Mars and with Saturn gives loss of kinsmen and of wealth; with Mercury, learning.
expected.sanskrit: बन्ध्वर्थक्षययोगाः कुजसौराभ्यां बुधेन पाण्डित्यम्
